description: This file defines the interface class IMediaPipelineService for media pipeline management in a server environment, including method declarations for session control, media loading, source attachment, playback controls, and media support queries.

classes.name: IMediaPipelineService
classes.description: An abstract interface class providing media pipeline session management and media control methods.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates a new media session with specified parameters.

methods.name: destroySession
methods.description: Destroys an existing media session identified by sessionId.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads media of a specific type and MIME type from a URL into a session.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source to a session.

methods.name: removeSource
methods.description: Removes a media source from a session.

methods.name: allSourcesAttached
methods.description: Checks if all sources are attached for a session.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts playback for a session.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses playback for a session.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops playback for a session.

methods.name: setPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate for a session.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Sets the playback position for a session.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Retrieves the current playback position for a session.

methods.name: setVideoWindow
methods.description: Sets the video window position and size for a session.

methods.name: haveData
methods.description: Indicates data availability and status for a session.

methods.name: renderFrame
methods.description: Renders a frame for a session.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume level for a session.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Retrieves the current volume level for a session.

methods.name: setMute
methods.description: Mutes or unmutes audio for a session.

methods.name: getMute
methods.description: Checks if audio is muted for a session.

methods.name: getSupportedMimeTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of supported MIME types for a given media source type.

methods.name: isMimeTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific MIME type is supported.
